about: HVACDUCTALIGN (AGENTS.md): reference = upper edge (y=300) of the first duct, aligned = lower edge (y=900) of the second duct. The second duct is translated perpendicular to the edge by -600 so that the edges are collinear (position (500,1200) -> (500,600)); the ducts are side by side, not coaxial, so nothing is joined and nothing else changes.

checks.name: second duct moved by -600 across, size kept
